auth.title: Sign in to Ricotdin
auth.subtitle: Continue to your meetings, notes, and assistant.

errors.missing: Enter your email or username and your password.
errors.invalid_credentials: That email, username or password is not right.
errors.email_not_verified: Please verify your email first. Check your inbox for the link.
errors.account_disabled: This account has been disabled. Contact an administrator.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.unavailable: Sign-up is not available right now. Try again later.

auth.signOutFailed: We could not end your session on the server. On a shared computer, sign in and sign out again, or close the browser.
auth.linkSent: If an account exists for that address, we have sent it a link. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
auth.forgotHelp: Enter the email of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.

validation.usernameShort: Username must be at least 3 characters.
validation.usernameLong: Username must be at most 30 characters.
validation.usernameChars: Use only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.
validation.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
validation.passwordLong: Password must be at most 256 characters.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Record meetings and get transcripts, notes and to-dos.
register.usernameHelp: 3–30 lowercase letters, digits, - or _. You can sign in with it.
register.sent: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. Open it to activate your account, then sign in.
register.notSent: Your account was created, but the verification email could not be sent right now. Ask for a new one from the sign-in page later.
register.taken: That email or username is already in use.
register.invalid: Check your details and try again.

verify.done: Your email is verified. You can sign in now.
verify.resendHelp: Need a new verification link? Enter your email.
verify.confirmHelp: Confirm that this is your email address to activate your account.

reset.help: Choose a new password. You will be signed out on every device.
reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.

page.comingSoon: This screen is being connected to the new backend.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.subtitle: Search, revisit, and ask questions across every conversation.

record.title: Record or upload
record.subtitle: Capture the conversation. Ricotdin will handle the rest.

chat.title: Ask your meetings
chat.subtitle: Answers include links back to the source.

profile.title: Profile & preferences
profile.subtitle: Manage your account, appearance, and usage.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.subtitle: The page you are looking for does not exist.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.subtitle: You need administrator rights to open this page.

admin.subtitle: Manage your workspace infrastructure, access, and operations.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The page hit an unexpected error. Reload to try again.
error.config: The app is not configured correctly. Contact an administrator.
error.unavailable: Cannot reach the server right now. Check your connection, then try again.

record.stopped: Recorded {{time}} ({{size}}). Listen back, then upload it for processing.
record.noTabAudio: No tab or system audio is being recorded — only your microphone. To include the other participants, stop, start again and tick "Share tab audio" in the sharing dialog.
record.noTabAudioAfter: This recording has only your microphone: tab or system audio was not shared.

card.title: Record this meeting
card.body: Capture your microphone and tab or system audio securely in your browser.

notice.title: Before you record
notice.body: This app will record and transcribe the meeting. Everyone taking part should know about the recording and agree to it before you start. Recording laws vary by location.
notice.script: “Before we begin: I'm going to record this meeting so I can transcribe it and take notes. Please let me know now if you don't want to be recorded.”

unsupported.title: This browser cannot record meetings
unsupported.body: Use a recent Chrome or Edge on a computer. You can still upload a recording below. Missing:

missing.codec: A supported audio format (WebM, Ogg or MP4)

errors.denied: Permission denied — allow microphone and screen access, then try again.
errors.noMic: No microphone found — connect a microphone and try again.
errors.state: The recorder stopped unexpectedly — try again.
errors.generic: Recording could not start. Try again.

record.leaveConfirm: You have a recording or upload in progress. Leave this page and lose it?

upload.drop: Drop an audio or video file here
upload.formats: MP3, M4A, WAV, AAC, OGG, FLAC, WEBM or video (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, M4V) · max {{max}}
upload.done: Uploaded. Processing has started — it usually takes a few minutes.

errors.type: Unsupported file type “{{ext}}”. Use an audio or video file.
errors.size: The file is too large. The maximum is {{max}}.
errors.network: Upload interrupted — check your connection and try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many uploads right now. Wait a while, or delete unfinished uploads, then try again.
errors.unavailable: Storage is not available right now. Try again later.
errors.drive: The file could not be stored. Try again.
errors.confirm: The file was uploaded but could not be checked. Open your meetings list, or try again.
errors.avatarType: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.avatarSize: The image must be smaller than 2 MB.

upload.title: Upload a file

errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

insight.title: Your meeting memory is ready
insight.body_one: Ask Ricotdin about decisions, action items or anything discussed in your {{count}} processed meeting.
insight.body_other: Ask Ricotdin about decisions, action items or anything discussed in your {{count}} processed meetings.

empty.firstBody: Record or upload your first meeting to get a transcript, notes and to-dos.
empty.title: No meetings found
empty.body: Try changing your search or folder filter.

delete.title: Delete meeting?
delete.body: “{{title}}” will be deleted permanently, with its recording, transcript, notes, to-dos and chats.
delete.warning: Meeting deleted, but its recording could not be removed from storage. An administrator can clean it up.

share.title: Share “{{name}}”
share.help: People you add see every meeting in this folder. Editors can also rename meetings and update to-dos.
share.roleHelp: Viewer: can read and chat. Editor: can also rename meetings and update to-dos.
share.notFound: No account found with that email or username.
share.conflict: That person already has access, or it is you.

errors.duplicate: You already have a folder with that name.
errors.name: Enter a folder name (up to 100 characters).

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.chatNotice: The folder's chat history will be deleted.
delete.chatNoticeShared_one: The folder's chat history will be deleted for everyone, including the chats of its {{count}} shared member.
delete.chatNoticeShared_other: The folder's chat history will be deleted for everyone, including the chats of its {{count}} shared members.
delete.alsoMeetings_one: Also delete my {{count}} meeting in this folder
delete.alsoMeetings_other: Also delete my {{count}} meetings in this folder
delete.othersMoved_one: {{count}} meeting of another member goes back to its owner's “No folder”.
delete.othersMoved_other: {{count}} meetings of other members go back to their owners' “No folder”.
delete.meetingsGone: Your meetings in it will be deleted permanently.
delete.meetingsKept: Your meetings in it will be kept, under “No folder”.
